name: io.github.dashpilot-labs/dashpilot-mcp
description: DoorDash Drive deliveries over MCP — quote, dispatch, and track deliveries from your POS.

environmentVariables.name: DASHPILOT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: DashPilot Cloud service endpoint — defaults to the hosted instance; set only for local development

environmentVariables.name: DASHPILOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Install key issued by DashPilot Cloud when you register the install

environmentVariables.name: DASHPILOT_DRIVE_DEVELOPER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Developer ID from the DoorDash Developer Portal (sandbox keys work out of the box)

environmentVariables.name: DASHPILOT_DRIVE_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Key ID from the DoorDash Developer Portal

environmentVariables.name: DASHPILOT_DRIVE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Drive signing secret from the DoorDash Developer Portal — used only on this machine to sign short-lived JWTs

environmentVariables.name: DASHPILOT_DRIVE_ROUTING
environmentVariables.description: managed (default) or manual — whether the config's routing block may switch this install between DoorDash's own sandbox and production hosts
